name: K’ung I
bio: K’ung I (孔夷; Kong Yi; 11th–12th century) was a writer of ci, the Chinese song lyrics composed to set tunes, in the Song dynasty.
The single ci here is from the chinese-poetry dataset of Zhu Zumou's 1924 anthology Three Hundred Song Lyrics (宋词三百首), in simplified characters, with the tune name as title.

poems.title: 南浦 (Nan pu)
poems.author: K’ung I
poems.collection: 宋詞三百首 (Three Hundred Song Lyrics)
poems.text:
风悲画角，听单于、三弄落谯门。
投宿征骑，飞雪满孤村。
酒市渐闲灯火，正敲窗、乱叶舞纷纷。
送数声惊雁，下离烟水，嘹唳度寒云。
好在半胧溪月，到如今、无处不销魂。
故国梅花归梦，愁损绿罗裙。
为问暗香闲艳，也相思、万点付啼痕。
算翠屏应是，两眉馀恨倚黄昏。
